@@ -42,3 +44,23 @@ def __init__(
         self._settings["extra_headers"] = utils.parse_extra_headers(
             self._settings.get("extra_headers"), os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_HEADERS")
         )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_default_parameters(cls) -> ChatModelParameters:
+        # Leaves `temperature` unset, so `_transform_input` can tell the implicit 0 from a chosen one
+        return ChatModelParameters()
+
+    def _transform_input(self, input: ChatModelInput) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        params = super()._transform_input(input)
+
+        # `temperature` defaults to 0 for every provider, but Anthropic rejects it next to
+        # `top_p` and requires 1 when thinking is on. Only a value nobody asked for is dropped.
+        temperature_is_explicit = (
+            "temperature" in input.model_fields_set
+            or "temperature" in self.parameters.model_fields_set
+            or "temperature" in self._settings
+        )
+        if not temperature_is_explicit and any(key in params for key in ("top_p", "reasoning_effort", "thinking")):
+            params.pop("temperature", None)
+
+        return params

+class TestAnthropicImplicitTemperature:
+    """The implicit `temperature=0` must not turn a valid Anthropic request into a 400."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    async def _captured_request(**run_kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        captured: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        monkeypatch = pytest.MonkeyPatch()
+        monkeypatch.setattr(
+            "beeai_framework.adapters.litellm.chat.acompletion",
+            TestStopSequences._capturing_acompletion(captured),
+        )
+        try:
+            await AnthropicChatModel("claude-sonnet-4-6", api_key="test").run([UserMessage("hi")], **run_kwargs)
+        finally:
+            monkeypatch.undo()
+        return captured
+
+    @pytest.mark.unit
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_reasoning_effort_drops_the_implicit_temperature(self) -> None:
+        captured = await self._captured_request(reasoning_effort="low")
+
+        assert "temperature" not in captured
+        assert captured["reasoning_effort"] == "low"
+
+    @pytest.mark.unit
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_top_p_drops_the_implicit_temperature(self) -> None:
+        captured = await self._captured_request(top_p=0.9)
+
+        assert "temperature" not in captured
+        assert captured["top_p"] == 0.9
+
+    @pytest.mark.unit
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_explicit_temperature_is_kept(self) -> None:
+        captured = await self._captured_request(temperature=0.3, top_p=0.9)
+
+        assert captured["temperature"] == 0.3
+
+    @pytest.mark.unit
+    @pytest.mark.asyncio
+    async def test_temperature_is_still_sent_by_default(self) -> None:
+        captured = await self._captured_request()
+
+        assert captured["temperature"] == 0
